content_en.prompt: Shiny wants the apple pancake at the bottom of a stack of 3; pancakes are only taken from the top. After 1 is served, the cook adds 4 fresh ones (apple first, then 3 others) on top. A girl takes 2. The cook adds 4 more fresh ones on top (no apple this time).
content_en.question: What is the smallest number of pancakes that have to be taken before Shiny can get an apple pancake?
content_en.explanation: Tracking the stack step by step: after all additions/removals, apple pancakes end up 6th and 8th from the top of the final 8-pancake stack — so 5 pancakes must be served before reaching the nearer apple pancake (the 6th).
content_en.ct_explanation: The pile of pancakes represents a stack — a data structure where elements are added/removed Last-In-First-Out (LIFO), only from the top. Stacks are used in function calls (parameters pushed onto a stack) and local variable storage. Everyday examples: stacked plates/books, or the "undo" feature in software, which keeps changes on a stack.

content_zh.prompt: Shiny想要吃疊了3個鬆餅裡最底下的蘋果鬆餅；鬆餅只能從最上面拿。第一個被別人吃掉後，廚師又加了4個新鬆餅上去（先加蘋果口味，再加3個其他口味）。接著有個女生拿走了2個。廚師又加了4個新鬆餅上去（這次沒有蘋果口味）。
content_zh.question: 在Shiny拿到蘋果鬆餅之前，最少要先拿走幾個鬆餅？
content_zh.explanation: 逐步追蹤鬆餅堆的變化：所有加入跟拿走都結束後，最終這疊8個鬆餅裡，蘋果口味分別在從上數來第6個和第8個位置——所以最少要拿走5個鬆餅，才能拿到比較靠上面的那個蘋果鬆餅（第6個）。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這疊鬆餅正是一個「堆疊」(stack)——一種只能從最上面加入或取出元素的資料結構，遵循「後進先出」(LIFO)原則。堆疊被用在函式呼叫（參數會被推入堆疊）跟區域變數的儲存上。生活中的例子有：疊在一起的盤子或書本，還有軟體裡的「復原」(undo)功能——它就是把每次的變更存進一個堆疊裡。
